title: The Brides walk among us
changes: The Brides are now real companions: three pale brides (one more per rank) stay with the Vampire for 25s, throw themselves at every foe nearby, claw in a frenzy and drink for him.
Rat Plague is now a slow, seething wave of rats, and Bat Swarm pours smoothly out of the cloak with 2 more bats per rank.
Vampire skills now take 3 or 5 points each: 5 where every rank adds something you can count (more bats, more rats, more foes pierced), 3 for the rest.
